purpose: Represent repeated point-in-time provider expected-line snapshots for the same race so mutable pre-event line information can be detected without post-race reconstruction.
principles: Only PRE_EVENT_EXPECTED_LINE is admitted at this gate.
Every snapshot must have capture_timestamp <= decision_cutoff.
Snapshots for the same race are ordered by capture timestamp.
A changed partition or changed within-line order is represented as an observed provider-forecast change, not as a tactical truth event.
An unchanged pair is transport/stability support only and is not a population stability-rate estimate.
LEGSHOW_OBSERVED_LINE remains a separate protected admission class.
No result, payout, odds, candidate performance, or economic information is used.
No numerical tactical probability or line-change probability is estimated here.
